name: Washerwoman
description: On the first night, learn a Townsfolk character held by one of two players.

name: Librarian
description: On the first night, learn an Outsider character held by one of two players, or learn that no Outsiders are in play.

name: Investigator
description: On the first night, learn a Minion character held by one of two players.

name: Chef
description: On the first night, learn the number of adjacent evil pairs around the table.

name: Empath
description: Each night, learn how many of your nearest living neighbors are evil.

name: Fortune Teller
description: Each night, check two players for a Demon. One good player is a permanent false positive.

name: Undertaker
description: After an execution that caused death, learn the executed character that night.

name: Monk
description: After the first night, choose someone other than yourself to protect from the Demon that night.

name: Ravenkeeper
description: If you die at night, choose someone and learn their character.

name: Virgin
description: Your first nomination consumes your ability. If the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.

name: Slayer
description: Once, during the day, publicly choose someone. If they register as the Demon, they die.

name: Soldier
description: While healthy, you are safe from the Demon.

name: Mayor
description: Good can win with three living players and no execution. A night attack on you may be redirected.

name: Butler
description: Choose a master each night. While alive, your yes vote requires your master to vote yes.

name: Drunk
description: You are shown an out-of-play Townsfolk character and act as that character, but its ability has no effect.

name: Recluse
description: You may register as evil or as a Minion or Demon, even while dead.

name: Saint
description: If your ability works when you die by execution, evil wins.

name: Poisoner
description: Choose someone each night to disable their ability until the next dusk without telling them.

name: Spy
description: Each night, inspect the full game state. You may register as good or as a Townsfolk or Outsider.

name: Scarlet Woman
description: If the Demon dies with at least five players alive just before death, you become the Demon.

name: Baron
description: During setup, replace two Townsfolk with two additional Outsiders.

name: Imp
description: After the first night, choose someone to kill. Killing yourself passes the Imp to a living Minion.
